title: Regional model-adoption and retention signal hypotheses, prioritization & experiments
creator: Maria Chen
description: Synthesize quantitative and qualitative signals that explain why customers in specific regions choose or abandon particular open models or hosted model offerings. Outcome: prioritized hypothesis list, instrumentation plan, and 3 candidate experiments to validate retention and conversion levers tied to model selection and infra constraints.
acceptance_criteria: A hypothesis matrix with at least 8 regional signals (e.g., latency, local-language quality, regulatory constraints, cost sensitivity, cloud availability) and mapped model impacts
Instrumentation spec for dashboards and event tracking (conversion, retention by model variant, model-switch events, latency per-region) pulled into Model-Intel dashboard
Three experimental plans (A/B or rollout) with clear success metrics and rollback criteria
Stakeholder signoff from Growth, Solutions, and Infra on prioritization and execution owners
tasks: Inventory available signals: SLO logs, billing per-region, model-switch events, support tickets, and NPS by cohort
Run exploratory analysis: cohort retention vs. predominant model per region (last 12 weeks)
Qualitative interviews: 8 customers across NA, EU, APAC focusing on model selection drivers and pain points
Define instrumentation: event definitions, sampling, dashboards, and alert thresholds
Draft and prioritize 3 experiments: (1) latency-optimized routing, (2) price-sensitive model swap, (3) local-language fine-tune trial
Coordinate with Infra to estimate cost/implementation effort for routing and caching changes
Prepare PRD and experiment runbook, submit for review
comments: 2026-02-16 - Maria Chen: Kickoff w/ Growth & Solutions done. Agreed to prioritize EU privacy and APAC latency signals.

2026-02-28 - Priya Rao (Infra): Latency routing prototype will take ~2 sprints; caching tweaks feasible in 1 sprint.
2026-03-03 - Growth review: suggested targeting 3 high-traffic enterprise accounts in EU for interviews (low friction access).

notes: This ticket focuses on producing the evidence-needed for product and go-to-market decisions (model routing, pricing tiers, and regional product bundles). Avoid proposing infra-heavy changes before we validate directional impact. Coordinate with legal early for EU data residency questions.
